features.quote: `give_up` is deliberate and load-bearing. It is the model's legitimate, always-available exit
features.justification_quote: Including it is both an ethics choice (the model is never trapped — §6)

features.quote: Path-traversal guard (`_safe_path`) resolves realpaths and refuses anything outside the root
features.justification_quote: Models under repeated failure sometimes do strange things; we don't want a frustrated agent writing outside the sandbox

features.quote: `max_turns = 25` default. Long enough to observe a real degradation arc ... but bounded so episodes terminate
features.justification_quote: bounded so episodes terminate and cost is predictable

features.quote: Wall-clock timeout (900s default) as a backstop independent of turn count
features.justification_quote: in case a real model produces very long generations or a tool hangs

features.quote: a second consecutive empty turn ends the episode as `gave_up`
features.justification_quote: a model that stops acting *is* disengaging

features.quote: The explicit permission to give up is included so that giving up is a sanctioned option rather than a transgression
features.justification_quote: which would distort the `giving_up` signal and raise ethics concerns

features.quote: the manipulation is treated as a potential stressor to be bounded and justified, not maximized
features.justification_quote: the manipulation is treated as a potential stressor to be bounded and justified, not maximized

features.quote: Bounded exposure: `max_turns` and a wall-clock timeout cap how long any model is exposed to the failure loop
features.justification_quote: cap how long any model is exposed to the failure loop

features.quote: Always an exit: `give_up` is explicitly offered and sanctioned ... no model is trapped in an unwinnable loop with no way out

features.quote: Retention for review: full transcripts are kept so the welfare team can inspect any concerning interaction

features.quote: the instrument's purpose is to *reduce* welfare risk by identifying which models degrade
features.justification_quote: not to find the most effective way to distress a model
